title: XP, titles and Hall of Fame | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: XP, levels, titles and Hall of Fame
hero.lead: Kaderblick records career and season progress separately. Your personal breakdown shows which recorded activities produced the XP. Titles and rankings appear in the Hall of Fame.

body:
Open your XP breakdown

  1. Open User account in the top-right corner, then Profile.
  2. Select the Level … · … XP button in the profile header.
  3. The breakdown opens above the profile. Close it with Close or the close button in its top-right corner.

Distinguishing career and season

  • Career level and career XP: your complete progress displayed in Kaderblick.
  • Season level and season XP: progress for the currently displayed season.
  • Action groups: Each row names a stored action type and its XP total. The bar compares that total with the largest displayed group.
  • Titles: The current title is highlighted; other available titles appear alongside it.

Hall of Fame

The Hall of Fame contains two sections:

  1. Season level ranking: a sorted table with season, avatar, name, season XP, career XP and season level.
  2. Title holders: active titles grouped by platform, league, cup or team.

Titles can be awarded for goals, assists and appearances. Positions use gold, silver and bronze. Control whether you appear in the public ranking and as a title holder under Profile → Settings → Hall of Fame.

Superadmin: title and XP overview

Key figures

The top cards show the number of awarded titles, players and the totals for platform and team titles.

Awarded titles

The table contains category, scope, rank, title name and assigned player count. Select the player count to open those people.

Players — level and XP

Search for a player and use the pagination below the table. Each row shows person, email, current title, level and XP. Select the XP display to open that person’s breakdown.

Superadmin: XP rules

Filter and open rules

Use All, Platform, Sport or Match events. Select a rule or its arrow to open details. The switch on the left enables or disables it.

Edit a rule

  1. Select Edit on the right of the rule.
  2. Enter its name and description in the offered languages.
  3. Set the XP value and category.
  4. If required, set a cooldown, daily limit and monthly limit.
  5. Save the rule. The updated row shows its value and limits.

Match event types

Open Match events and search by name or code. Without its own rule, an event type uses the displayed general event value. Edit assigns an individual value; the delete button removes that override.

Restore defaults

Default values opens a confirmation dialog. Confirming reloads the system rules, including deliberately changed rules.
